outcome: Luteal support in the first trimester
cohort: Nulliparous Chinese women who achieved singleton pregnancies naturally
finding: Nulliparous women with endometriosis have a significantly higher risk of preterm labor, placenta previa, and cesarean section compared to nulliparous women without endometriosis.
mod_finding: This study found that women with endometriosis had a higher risk of cesarean section during pregnancy compared to women without endometriosis.
